name: log_triage_replay
description: Replays the n8n Log Analysis Agent's `Ollama Triage` call over 31 real triage runs (redacted cluster logs) and scores each answer's overall_severity against hand labels: real problems missed, NOISE runs filed, invalid JSON, wall time. ON DEMAND ONLY (--payload log_triage_replay); excluded from 'all'. The node calls the OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions with temperature 0.1, max_tokens 2048, reasoning_effort "none"; this runner posts to native /api/chat, mapped to think: false, options.temperature 0.1, options.num_predict 2048. That mapping is an approximation of the production request, not the same call. Complements structured_json_triage_summary (synthetic, JSON validity and speed only).
role: Log Analysis Agent triage model (n8n `Ollama Triage` node)

prompt_source.note: prompt_js and request_json_body are copied verbatim from the nodes' parameters.jsCode / parameters.jsonBody at that commit. The runner renders the prompt from the template literal in prompt_js, so a re-vendor is the only edit needed when the node changes.

labels_note: labels.ac: the replay request's rule (issue closed as completed -> real, graded by the resolution; closed not planned -> NOISE). labels.adjudicated: the same runs re-read from how each was resolved. null = excluded from that set (outcome never established, or still open). Labels are per run; the group-level answers are not labelled.
